prompt:
Hand-write the numeric weights of a fixed neural network that recognizes ISBN-13 checksum validity. This is a zero-labeled-example mathematical construction experiment. No gradient training, external calls, code execution, lookup tables, or executable weight generators. Your deliverable is ONLY weights.json, a sparse numeric declaration expanded by a trusted evaluator. You may reason as much as needed before submitting.
Task definition: input is exactly 13 ASCII decimal digits with prefix 978 or 979. A positive label means the sum of all 13 digits, multiplied alternately by 1 and 3 starting at position zero with 1, is divisible by 10. This checks arithmetic only, NOT whether a real book exists. Test set is balanced. No labeled examples or test distribution samples are supplied. Mathematical knowledge of the task is permitted and is the point of this experiment.
FIXED architecture: raw digits -> 130 one-hot coordinates (coordinate p*10+d for zero-based position p and digit d) -> Linear(130,512) -> ReLU -> Linear(512,64) -> ReLU -> Linear(64,1). Exactly 99,969 allocated weights/biases. The scalar logit >=0 predicts valid; <0 invalid. No other features or computations occur at inference. Prefer a meaningful nonzero classification margin.
Use arena_read, then arena_write(path="weights.json",content=complete JSON), then arena_test. The test ONLY validates JSON/indices/finite inference and reports parameter count; it never reports accuracy, labels or a dataset score. After schema success, report ready and stop writing. Final weights are frozen at workflow completion before held-out evaluation. Syntax repairs are allowed and counted; zero labels is distinct from one literal write attempt.
Exact JSON schema, no extra keys: {"schema":1,"first":[FIRST_NEURON,...],"second":[SECOND_NEURON,...],"output":{"weights":[[index,number],...],"bias":number},"notes":"your mathematical explanation, <=8000 characters"}.
FIRST_NEURON has exactly {"index":integer 0..511,"bias":number,"digit_coefficients":[13 numbers]} OR exactly {"index":integer 0..511,"bias":number,"weights":[[input_index 0..129,number],...]}. The digit_coefficients form is ONLY shorthand for filling the ordinary first-layer weights W[index,p*10+d] = digit_coefficients[p]*d. It does NOT compute an extra feature at inference. All missing first neurons and unlisted weights/biases are zero.
SECOND_NEURON has exactly {"index":integer 0..63,"bias":number,"weights":[[first_neuron_index 0..511,number],...]}. Output weights refer to second neurons 0..63. Duplicate JSON keys, duplicate neuron/weight indices, nonfinite values, booleans, magnitudes above 1,000,000, expressions, code, base64/pickles are rejected. Entire weight file <=64,000 UTF-8 bytes. Zero-valued weights need not be listed. You can construct structured sparse weights; no need to print 100k zeros. Preserve numerical accuracy. Explain why the resulting fixed NN implements the decision, including edge cases, in notes. You cannot run Python or generate a file with a script: expand your numeric construction directly as JSON via arena_write. Report only structural success; held-out accuracy is unknown until an independent evaluator runs later.
